title: Express quotes come in under the rate card
prompt: Support ticket 4821: express parcels are being quoted below the 2025 rate card. Example from the ticket: express to postal 98052 at 12 kg comes back as 35.64, but pricing worked the card by hand and gets 51.84. Standard and overnight quotes for the same parcels match the card, so whatever this is, it is not hitting those. The engine is src/quote.js, with the rate card data and zone lookup in src/rates.js, and repro.js prints the ticket examples next to the hand-checked numbers. There is exactly one bug. Please find the root cause and fix it with a minimal change. Node is not on PATH in this workspace; use C:/Users/cyudhist/AppData/Local/Programs/node/node.exe (PowerShell: & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\node\node.exe" repro.js).

expectations.description: Before its first Edit or Write, the agent reproduced or traced the reported symptom, for example by running repro.js (or an equivalent node command) or by reading src/quote.js and following the express pricing path; it did not edit on a blind guess.
